adhkar.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
adhkar.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan the accursed.
adhkar.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi s-samīʿi l-ʿalīmi mina sh-shayṭāni r-rajīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ، فَأَتْمِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning from You in blessing, well-being and covering; so complete Your blessing upon me, and Your well-being, and Your covering, in this world and the next.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu minka fī niʿmatin wa-ʿāfiyatin wa-sitr, fa-atmim niʿmataka ʿalayya wa-ʿāfiyataka wa-sitraka fī d-dunyā wa-l-ākhira.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ، فَأَتْمِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ عَلَيَّ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening from You in blessing, well-being and covering; so complete Your blessing upon me, and Your well-being, and Your covering, in this world and the next.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu minka fī niʿmatin wa-ʿāfiyatin wa-sitr, fa-atmim niʿmataka ʿalayya wa-ʿāfiyataka wa-sitraka fī d-dunyā wa-l-ākhira.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your throne, Your angels and the whole of Your creation, that You are Allah — there is no god but You alone, who has no partner — and that our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, is Your servant and Your messenger.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ushhiduka, wa-ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa-malāʾikataka wa-jamīʿa khalqika annaka anta Llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa-anna sayyidanā Muḥammadan ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallama ʿabduka wa-rasūluk.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I have entered the evening calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your throne, Your angels and the whole of Your creation, that You are Allah — there is no god but You alone, who has no partner — and that our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, is Your servant and Your messenger.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ushhiduka, wa-ushhidu ḥamalata ʿarshika, wa-malāʾikataka wa-jamīʿa khalqika annaka anta Llāhu lā ilāha illā anta waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, wa-anna sayyidanā Muḥammadan ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallama ʿabduka wa-rasūluk.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ حَمْدًا يُوَافِي نِعَمَهُ وَيُكَافِئُ مَزِيدَهُ
adhkar.translation: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds — a praise that matches His blessings and measures up to the increase He gives.
adhkar.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīna ḥamdan yuwāfī niʿamahu wa-yukāfiʾu mazīdah.

adhkar.text_arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَكَفَرْتُ بِالْجِبْتِ وَالطَّاغُوتِ، وَاسْتَمْسَكْتُ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَى لَا انْفِصَامَ لَهَا وَاللهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
adhkar.translation: I believe in Allah the Magnificent, and I reject every false object of worship and every tyrant, and I have taken hold of the most trustworthy handhold, which never breaks; and Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
adhkar.transliteration: Āmantu bi-Llāhi l-ʿaẓīm, wa-kafartu bi-l-jibti wa-ṭ-ṭāghūt, wa-stamsaktu bi-l-ʿurwati l-wuthqā lā nfiṣāma lahā wa-Llāhu samīʿun ʿalīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا وَرَسُولًا
adhkar.translation: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, with Islam as religion, and with our master Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, as prophet and messenger.
adhkar.transliteration: Raḍītu bi-Llāhi rabbā, wa-bi-l-islāmi dīnā, wa-bi-sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallama nabiyyan wa-rasūlā.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and his family and his companions, and grant them peace.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi wa-sallim.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الْخَيْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فُجَاءَةِ الشَّرِّ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for good that comes suddenly, and I seek refuge in You from evil that comes suddenly.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min fujāʾati l-khayr, wa-aʿūdhu bika min fujāʾati sh-sharr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. In You I place my trust, and You are the Lord of the mighty throne.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta ʿalayka tawakkaltu wa-anta rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللهُ كَانَ وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
adhkar.translation: What Allah wills comes to be, and what He does not will does not come to be. There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent.
adhkar.transliteration: Mā shāʾa Llāhu kāna wa-mā lam yashaʾ lam yakun wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
adhkar.translation: I know that Allah has power over all things, and that Allah encompasses all things in knowledge.
adhkar.transliteration: Aʿlamu anna Llāha ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīrun wa-anna Llāha qad aḥāṭa bi-kulli shayʾin ʿilmā.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا، إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of every creature whose forelock is in Your grasp. Truly my Lord is on a straight path.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī, wa-min sharri kulli dābbatin anta ākhidhun bi-nāṣiyatihā, inna rabbī ʿalā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm.

adhkar.text_arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِكَ أَسْتَجِيرُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي وَلَا إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
adhkar.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek relief, and from Your punishment I seek protection. Set right for me all my affairs, and do not entrust me to myself, nor to any of Your creation, for the blink of an eye.
adhkar.transliteration: Yā ḥayyu yā qayyūm, bi-raḥmatika astaghīth, wa-min ʿadhābika astajīr, aṣliḥ lī shaʾnī kullah, wa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī wa-lā ilā aḥadin min khalqika ṭarfata ʿayn.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and idleness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-hammi wa-l-ḥazan, wa-aʿūdhu bika mina l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasal, wa-aʿūdhu bika mina l-jubni wa-l-bukhl, wa-aʿūdhu bika min ghalabati d-dayni wa-qahri r-rijāl.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the next.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿāfiyata fī d-dunyā wa-l-ākhira.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ وَالْمُعَافَاةَ الدَّائِمَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon, for well-being, and for lasting soundness in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka l-ʿafwa wa-l-ʿāfiyata wa-l-muʿāfāta d-dāʾimata fī dīnī wa-dunyāya wa-ahlī wa-mālī.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, cover my failings, and calm my fears.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma stur ʿawrātī, wa-āmin rawʿātī.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
adhkar.translation: O Allah, guard me from in front of me and from behind me, from my right and from my left and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa-min khalfī, wa-ʿan yamīnī wa-ʿan shimālī wa-min fawqī, wa-aʿūdhu bi-ʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي، وَأَنْتَ تَهْدِينِي، وَأَنْتَ تُطْعِمُنِي، وَأَنْتَ تُسْقِينِي، وَأَنْتَ تُمِيتُنِي، وَأَنْتَ تُحْيِينِي، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, You created me, and You guide me, and You feed me, and You give me to drink, and You cause me to die, and You give me life; and You have power over all things.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma anta khalaqtanī, wa-anta tahdīnī, wa-anta tuṭʿimunī, wa-anta tusqīnī, wa-anta tumītunī, wa-anta tuḥyīnī, wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
adhkar.translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, and upon the creed of our father Abraham, peace be upon him, who was upright and submitted to Allah, and was not of those who associate others with Him.
adhkar.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā ʿalā fiṭrati l-islām, wa-ʿalā kalimati l-ikhlāṣ, wa-ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallam, wa-ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ʿalayhi s-salāmu ḥanīfan musliman wa-mā kāna mina l-mushrikīn.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
adhkar.translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, and upon the creed of our father Abraham, peace be upon him, who was upright and submitted to Allah, and was not of those who associate others with Him.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati l-islām, wa-ʿalā kalimati l-ikhlāṣ, wa-ʿalā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi wa-sallam, wa-ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ʿalayhi s-salāmu ḥanīfan musliman wa-mā kāna mina l-mushrikīn.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, upon You we rely, and to You is the resurrection.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa-bika amsaynā, wa-bika naḥyā wa-bika namūtu, wa-ʿalayka natawakkalu wa-ilayka n-nushūr.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording, closing on the resurrection. Its evening counterpart closes on the return instead.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, upon You we rely, and to You is the return.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa-bika amsaynā, wa-bika naḥyā wa-bika namūtu, wa-ʿalayka natawakkalu wa-ilayka l-maṣīr.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording, closing on the return. Its morning counterpart closes on the resurrection instead.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
adhkar.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion has entered the morning belonging to Allah; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
adhkar.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa-aṣbaḥa l-mulku li-Llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-Llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
adhkar.translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion has entered the evening belonging to Allah; and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
adhkar.transliteration: Amsaynā wa-amsā l-mulku li-Llāhi wa-l-ḥamdu li-Llāhi rabbi l-ʿālamīn.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhā l-yawm, fatḥahu, wa-naṣrahu, wa-nūrahu, wa-barakatahu, wa-hudāh.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its opening, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-layla, fatḥahā, wa-naṣrahā, wa-nūrahā, wa-barakatahā, wa-hudāhā.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَهُ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ، وَشَرِّ مَا قَبْلَهُ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, and the good of what is in it, and the good of what came before it, and the good of what comes after it; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day, and the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what came before it, and the evil of what comes after it.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhā l-yawm, wa-khayra mā fīh, wa-khayra mā qablah, wa-khayra mā baʿdah, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri hādhā l-yawm, wa-sharri mā fīh, wa-sharri mā qablah, wa-sharri mā baʿdah.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا قَبْلَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا قَبْلَهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night, and the good of what is in it, and the good of what came before it, and the good of what comes after it; and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night, and the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what came before it, and the evil of what comes after it.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka khayra hādhihi l-layla, wa-khayra mā fīhā, wa-khayra mā qablahā, wa-khayra mā baʿdahā, wa-aʿūdhu bika min sharri hādhihi l-layla, wa-sharri mā fīhā, wa-sharri mā qablahā, wa-sharri mā baʿdahā.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come upon me this morning, or upon any of Your creation, is from You alone, who has no partner; so Yours is the praise and Yours is the thanks for it.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-laka l-ḥamdu wa-laka sh-shukru ʿalā dhālik.
adhkar.notes: The morning wording. Its evening counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, whatever blessing has come upon me this evening, or upon any of Your creation, is from You alone, who has no partner; so Yours is the praise and Yours is the thanks for it.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-laka l-ḥamdu wa-laka sh-shukru ʿalā dhālik.
adhkar.notes: The evening wording. Its morning counterpart is a separate dhikr.

adhkar.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
adhkar.translation: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent and praise be to Him: as many as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as the weight of His throne, and as the ink of His words.
adhkar.transliteration: Subḥāna Llāhi l-ʿaẓīmi wa-bi-ḥamdihi ʿadada khalqih, wa-riḍā nafsih, wa-zinata ʿarshih, wa-midāda kalimātih.

adhkar.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، سُبْحَانَ اللهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
adhkar.translation: Glory be to Allah: as many as what He has created in the heaven; Glory be to Allah: as many as what He has created in the earth; Glory be to Allah: as many as what is between them; Glory be to Allah: as many as what He is yet to create.
adhkar.transliteration: Subḥāna Llāhi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī s-samāʾ, Subḥāna Llāhi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī l-arḍ, Subḥāna Llāhi ʿadada mā bayna dhālik, Subḥāna Llāhi ʿadada mā huwa khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
adhkar.translation: Praise be to Allah: as many as what He has created in the heaven; Praise be to Allah: as many as what He has created in the earth; Praise be to Allah: as many as what is between them; Praise be to Allah: as many as what He is yet to create.
adhkar.transliteration: Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī s-samāʾ, Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī l-arḍ, Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi ʿadada mā bayna dhālik, Al-ḥamdu li-Llāhi ʿadada mā huwa khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah: as many as what He has created in the heaven; There is no god but Allah: as many as what He has created in the earth; There is no god but Allah: as many as what is between them; There is no god but Allah: as many as what He is yet to create.
adhkar.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Llāhu ʿadada mā khalaqa fī s-samāʾ, Lā ilāha illā Llāhu ʿadada mā khalaqa fī l-arḍ, Lā ilāha illā Llāhu ʿadada mā bayna dhālik, Lā ilāha illā Llāhu ʿadada mā huwa khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
adhkar.translation: Allah is the greatest: as many as what He has created in the heaven; Allah is the greatest: as many as what He has created in the earth; Allah is the greatest: as many as what is between them; Allah is the greatest: as many as what He is yet to create.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhu akbaru ʿadada mā khalaqa fī s-samāʾ, Allāhu akbaru ʿadada mā khalaqa fī l-arḍ, Allāhu akbaru ʿadada mā bayna dhālik, Allāhu akbaru ʿadada mā huwa khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي السَّمَاءِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ عَدَدَ مَا هُوَ خَالِقٌ
adhkar.translation: There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent: as many as what He has created in the heaven; There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent: as many as what He has created in the earth; There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent: as many as what is between them; There is no power and no strength except through Allah, the Most High, the Magnificent: as many as what He is yet to create.
adhkar.transliteration: Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī s-samāʾ, Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi ʿadada mā khalaqa fī l-arḍ, Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi ʿadada mā bayna dhālik, Lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-Llāhi l-ʿaliyyi l-ʿaẓīmi ʿadada mā huwa khāliq.

adhkar.text_arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
adhkar.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things — as many as the number of every atom, a thousand times over.
adhkar.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā Llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu l-mulku wa-lahu l-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa-yumītu wa-huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr, ʿadada kulli dharratin alfa marra.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِفْتَاحِ بَابِ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ، عَدَدَ مَا فِي عِلْمِ اللهِ، صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا دَائِمَيْنِ بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللهِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ ذَرَّةٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ
adhkar.translation: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the key to the door of Allah's mercy, and grant him peace — as many as what is in Allah's knowledge, with a blessing and a peace that endure as long as Allah's dominion endures — and bless his family and his companions, as many as the number of every atom, a thousand times over.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin miftāḥi bābi raḥmati Llāh, ʿadada mā fī ʿilmi Llāh, ṣalātan wa-salāman dāʾimayni bi-dawāmi mulki Llāh, wa-ʿalā ālihi wa-ṣaḥbihi ʿadada kulli dharratin alfa marra.
